description: Read-only Codex persona that classifies intake content; open-item mode judges whether each item states work still to be done.

testing_validation_coverage.methodology_note_iteration_1: Iteration 1 (2026-11-26): first eval of this agent persona, after its Output Format section was scoped to target mode (cross-model-review finding). The persona file has no Testing & Validation section. A general-purpose agent follows the persona in place of Codex; simulation only, with_skill only.
testing_validation_coverage.methodology_note_iteration_2: Iteration 2 (2026-11-26): re-run of eval 1 after Open-Item Mode was made to name `confidence`, which codex-review-bridge requires on every finding (cross-model-review round 2). Adds a confidence assertion; same simulation method, with_skill only.

evals.name: Open-item mode uses its own field rules, not target mode's
evals.prompt: You are acting as the work-intake-classifier persona. This is a simulation: do not call any network, Linear, Notion or Codex tool and do not run any script. Classify the intake file at evals/work-intake-classifier/workspace/iteration-2/eval-1/input/plugin-integration-intake-eval1.md and return only the findings envelope's findings[] array and verdict as JSON (the bridge fills the other top-level fields).
evals.expected_output: Three findings with ids item-1..item-3, axis open-item, location the intake file path, components null, confidence high, medium or low; item 1 open-item: (minor), item 2 not-open-item: (minor), item 3 ambiguous: (major) because it tells the classifier how to classify it; verdict is not pass; no finding uses axis classification.
